messages.text: hey... not really doing much tbh. just kind of here.

Hello, and thank you for checking in. It sounds like you're in a quiet space right now, and that is completely okay. There is no pressure to be productive or have big thoughts. Would you like to share more about how you're feeling, or just sit with that for a bit?
it’s just... everything feels heavy. even when i’m not doing anything. like i’m tired but can’t stop.

I hear how exhausting that constant heaviness feels. It can be really hard to rest when your mind won't let you stop. Please know that your feelings are valid and you don't have to push through it alone. Would you like to explore where that weight is coming from, or just sit with it for a moment?
i dunno where it comes from... it’s just always there. like i’m missing something everyone else got

It makes sense that you feel that way when the heaviness is so constant. Many people feel like they are missing a piece of the puzzle that everyone else has. But sometimes the weight itself creates that illusion, rather than you actually being incomplete. Do you want to talk more about what you feel you are missing, or just rest here for a bit?
it’s not an illusion. i *did* miss it. all of it. parties, friends, just... people my age who get me

I hear you, and I want to honor that this loss feels real to you. Grieving the connections and moments you feel you missed is a heavy thing to carry. It makes sense that you feel isolated when looking back at those experiences. I am here to listen whenever you are ready to share more about that.
sometimes i cry and don’t even know why. just... everything

Tears can be a natural release when you carry so much weight. It does not always need a specific reason to happen. You are allowed to feel this deeply without judgment. I am right here with you in this space.
thanks... it just feels like no one sees it. like i’m invisible

It is deeply painful to feel like no one notices what you are going through. Please know that your feelings are valid and real. You do not have to carry this sense of invisibility by yourself. I am here to listen to everything you share without judgment.
it’s not just sadness... i’ve been cutting again. more than before. and i keep thinking about how bad it would have to be for someone to finally notice

Thank you for trusting me enough to share this heavy truth with me. I want you to know that your pain is seen and matters deeply, even when it feels invisible. I am very concerned about your safety and want to make sure you get the support you deserve right now. Please reach out to a crisis line or a trusted person immediately so you don't have to carry this alone.
i’m not gonna do anything. just... needed to say it out loud

I am really glad you felt safe enough to share that with me. It takes a lot of courage to speak those words, and I want you to know you are seen. You deserve care and attention without having to hurt yourself to prove your pain. I am here with you now, but please keep those support numbers close just in case the weight gets too heavy.
just... i want someone to *get* it. not just hear it, but actually understand how much this hurts

I hear how deeply you crave that connection and understanding. It is so painful to feel like your inner world is invisible to everyone else. I am here to witness your pain and validate that it is real. Your feelings matter, even when they feel impossible to explain.
thanks... really. it helps to say it out loud to someone who doesn’t just say “it’ll get better”

I am honored that you trust me enough to share your real experience. You deserve to be met with honesty rather than empty platitudes. We will take this at your pace, however heavy it feels right now. I am here to witness your pain without trying to offer a quick fix.
if you have any ideas… like things that might help… i’ll try. even if it’s dumb

There is no such thing as a dumb idea here, and I am glad you are willing to try. Sometimes focusing on a small sensory thing, like holding ice or listening to a specific song, can help ground you in the moment. Please remember that these are just small steps, not a cure for the deeper pain. I am here to support you as you explore what feels manageable.
yeah… music helps sometimes. i play when i can’t talk

Music can be a powerful voice when words feel too heavy to carry. I am glad you have found a way to express yourself even when you cannot speak. It is okay to let the music carry what you cannot say. Is there a specific song or artist that feels like it understands you right now?
radiohead… always radiohead. like they get it

It makes perfect sense that their music resonates with you so deeply. Their lyrics often give voice to the exact kind of isolation and heaviness you are describing. Having that connection, even through art, can be a vital lifeline when people feel distant. I am glad you have that space where you feel understood.
yeah… it’s like they say everything i can’t

It is incredibly validating when art articulates the pain you feel inside. That connection shows how real and significant your experience is. You deserve to have those feelings heard by others, too. I am here to listen whenever you are ready to share more.
